stories.title: The Little Angel's First Good Deed
stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.blurb: Lily is a little angel with a big heart. When she meets a tiny bluebird who has lost its family, Lily sets off on a gentle adventure to help. Along the way, she discovers that even the smallest act of kindness can make someone's day brighter. A heart-warming bedtime story about compassion, friendship, and the joy of helping others.
pages: High above the clouds
where the sky was bright and peaceful
lived a little angel called Lily.  Lily had soft white wings
a glowing golden halo
and the kindest smile.  She loved helping everyone.  One morning
Lily flew to Angel School.  The teacher smiled at all the little angels.  "Today's lesson is about kindness
" she said.  "Your first good deed doesn't have to be big. Even the smallest act of kindness can make someone's day brighter."  Lily wondered
What kind thing can I do today?  As she flew through the sky
she spotted a tiny bluebird sitting quietly on a branch.  "What's wrong?" Lily asked gently.  "I can't find my family
" chirped the little bird sadly.  "Don't worry
" said Lily. "I'll help you."  Together
they flew from tree to tree.  They looked in the tall trees.  They looked near the little stream.  They even looked beside a colourful flower garden.  At last

they heard cheerful chirping.  "There they are!" cried the little bird.  The bird's family fluttered over with happy little tweets.  "Thank you!" they chirped.  Lily smiled.  Helping someone felt warm and wonderful.  As the sun began to set
Lily returned to Angel School.  "Did you do your first good deed?" asked the teacher.  "Yes
" said Lily with a smile.  "I helped a little bird find its family."  The teacher nodded proudly.  "You gave your time
your kindness

and your caring heart. That is what being an angel is all about."  Lily looked up at the twinkling stars.  She realised that even the smallest act of kindness could make the world a little brighter.  That night
Lily went to sleep with a happy heart
ready for another day of spreading kindness. Bedtime Thought: A small act of kindness can make a big difference.

stories.title: Pockets Full of Pebbles
stories.author: Storiesbylity
stories.blurb: A girl who collects one pebble from every place she visits learns what she's really been keeping.
pages: Mira kept a pebble from everywhere she'd ever been sad, or surprised, or simply stood still long enough to notice something. Her pockets always sagged a little from the weight of it.

"Why keep the sad ones?" her grandmother asked one evening, turning a gray, rough pebble over in her palm. Mira thought about it for a long time. "Because I was there," she said finally, "and I want to remember that I got through it."

Her grandmother smiled and added a pebble of her own to the pile — smooth, and pale, and very old. "Then here's one from a very long time ago," she said, "from a day I got through too." Mira's pockets were heavy that night, but for the first time, they didn't feel like a weight at all.

stories.title: The Very Patient Seed
stories.author: Storiesbylity
stories.blurb: A tiny seed waits out the whole winter, certain that spring is coming — even when no one else believes it.
pages: Under the snow, a small seed waited. The frost said, "Nothing grows here," and the wind agreed, howling the same thing over and over until it seemed true.
But the seed remembered something warm — a whisper from the sun, months ago, that had said simply, "wait for me." So it did. Through the longest, coldest weeks, it held on to that one small promise.
One morning the snow softened, and softened, and finally slipped away altogether. A single green shoot pushed up into the light, right where the sun had promised it would.

stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.blurb: Twinkle, a little star, just isn't ready for bed. While all the other stars drift off to sleep, Twinkle stays wide awake. With a little help from the gentle Moon and the peaceful night sky, Twinkle discovers why a good night's sleep is so important. A cosy bedtime story filled with warmth, comfort and sweet dreams.
stories.title: The Little Star Who Couldn't Sleep
pages: High above the world
where the night sky twinkled with thousands of stars
lived a little star called Twinkle.  Every evening
the stars shone brightly before settling down for a peaceful night's sleep.  But not Twinkle.  "I don't feel sleepy
" sighed the little star.  Twinkle floated from cloud to cloud
counted the fluffy clouds
and quietly hummed a little tune.  Still
sleep wouldn't come.  Just then
the gentle Moon noticed.  "Would you like a cosy bedtime cuddle?" asked the Moon with a warm smile.  Twinkle nodded happily.  The Moon wrapped the little star in a blanket of soft
silvery light.  Below
the trees swayed gently in the evening breeze.  The crickets sang their sleepy songs.  The owls softly called
"Hoo... hoo..."  Everything felt peaceful.  Everything felt safe.  Twinkle let out a tiny yawn.  Then another.  "I think I'm ready for bed
" whispered the little star.  The Moon smiled.  "Even the brightest stars need a good night's sleep."  Twinkle closed their little eyes.  Soon
the little star was fast asleep
dreaming of colourful rainbows
fluffy clouds
and happy children making wishes beneath the night sky.  When morning came
Twinkle woke up feeling bright
happy
and full of energy.  "I'm so glad I had a good night's sleep!" smiled Twinkle.  From that day on
Twinkle remembered that a good night's sleep helps every little star shine brightly. Bedtime Thought: A good night's sleep helps us wake up happy
refreshed
and ready for a brand-new day.
